title: Softmax
oneLine: Turn a vector of scores into a probability distribution.

paras: Softmax converts arbitrary real-valued scores (logits) into positive numbers that sum to one - a probability distribution. It is the output layer of nearly every classifier and the normalizer inside attention. The largest logit gets the most mass, but everything keeps a share, so it stays differentiable.

sections.texNote: Subtract the max before exponentiating for numerical stability.

sections.caption: Shift, exponentiate, normalize.

takeaways: Softmax maps logits to a probability distribution.
It is the classifier head and the attention normalizer.
Subtract the max for numerical stability.
